ASAS-SN describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and provides publication citations. CTAS may link an operator to the official HTTPS coordinate-query page. No automated provider-data request was sent. The official legacy HTTPS query form requires reCAPTCHA and says users needing more than 100 light curves should contact ASAS-SN. The published V2 client and documentation currently use an unencrypted HTTP API, while the linked HTTPS V2 host and client repository are unavailable. This is an interface-integrity boundary, not a claim that the public light-curve data are proprietary.
